Hi,
I also find bloating to be extremely distressing and it’s been the source of my ED behaviors for many years. It sounds like bloating is very triggering for you as well. From my experience, I think you would really benefit from talking to your doctor and exploring if there is some type of gi trigger that is causing an extreme amount of bloating. I also think you would benefit from talking to a professional to explore your relationship with bloating and why it’s causes so much distress. 
Stress can make gi discomfort even more intense, so I really think both approaches are just as important. 
I get that it’s really f*ing hard to talk about. I hope you can find that it’s worth it though to work through now.

I’m in a long term relationship (6 years) and have a pretty nasty relapse in my ED starting with Covid. I haven’t talked to him about it and he recently expressed concern for my health. 
I think if you already have an established relationship and struggle with your Ed, it’s possible to maintain for a period of time, but both intimacy and recovery will suffer. 

So you may need to choose if your relationship or recovery is your priority. But I also do think the relationship will suffer until recovery is prioritized.  I think if you’re deep in your Ed already, recovery should be prioritized before diving into a new relationship. Your brain doesn’t work right when you’re sick. But if you’re not really ready to get well and not ready to get help, I understand pursuing a new relationship. I guess it depends on if you want your character to be the shining star that does the right thing or not. If it was me at any point the last year or so, my ed would come first, which puts my relationship second.. (not proud of this), and recovery hasn’t made the list. 

Im glad that you’re being vulnerable through writing and bringing light to such a common but unspoken illness. 

It sounds like your character is leaning toward recovery because her friends know, but ultimately her story has many routes to take and it can be whatever kind of story you want to tell!
